note: THE FIXTURE BAR quince#80 set, half two — 'the false-positive side, which is the half that goes unmeasured'. An issue in NEITHER set produces nothing. Stated as a fixture because the failure it guards against is the one nobody notices: a channel that wakes a session for every issue in the repository is a channel a session learns to ignore, and an ignored channel is indistinguishable from an unwatched one. Here #99 is busy — a comment and a close in the same interval — and it is not declared, so the observation never carries it and the diff has nothing to say. The declared issue #71 is quiet, and its silence is also not an event.
